title: Second Station: Jesus Takes Up His Cross
text:
Consider how Jesus, in making this journey with the Cross on His shoulders, offered to His Father the death He was about to undergo, for us.

My Jesus, I embrace all the trials Thou hast willed for me until
death. I beg of Thee, by the merits of the pain in which Thou didst
suffer in carrying Thy Cross, to give me the graces and strength
necessary to carry mine with perfect patience and resignation.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
